podcast.title: Todd Kerns' Role
podcast.body: Todd Kerns, previously from Age of Electric, serves as the bass player and backup vocalist for Slash in his band, The Conspirators. This position represents a significant engagement for Kerns within an internationally recognized musical project. "Todd Kerns from Age of Electric has been working as the bass player in Back of Vocalist for Slash, yes, as in Guns and Roses Slash, in his band The Conspirators."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Post-Breakup Member Activities
xref.body: Following Age of Electric's original run, members pursued various projects: the Dahle brothers formed Limblifter, Todd Kerns became the bass player and backup vocalist for Slash in The Conspirators, and three other members joined Matthew Good's backup band. These transitions highlight the interconnectedness of Canadian musicians. "Todd Kerns from Age of Electric has been working as the bass player in Back of Vocalist for Slash, yes, as in Guns and Roses Slash, in his band The Conspirators."
